annotations.title: Share a Drive file by link

description: Make a Google Drive file readable by ANYONE who has its link (view and download, not edit) and return the link; remove:true takes that access away. Sharing publishes the file: call once without confirm, tell the user, then call again with confirm:true. A file already shared just returns its link. Read back from Drive. Free.

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed
